appearance_facts.fact: The title reads 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'. This is an inscription, not a visual measurement of the line.
The blue line begins at the 1,000 gridline level on the left axis.
The line rises to a local peak near 1,400 in 1881, dips slightly in 1882, and rises again to about 1,500 in 1883.
The line climbs to 2,000 in 1884, holds near 2,050 in 1885, then dips to about 1,800 in 1886.
The line rises steeply to about 2,100 in 1887, then to a peak near 2,950 in 1888, before dropping to about 2,600 in 1889.
The line reaches its highest point on the chart, approximately 3,300, in 1890, then falls to about 2,950 in 1891.
Despite the title's wording, the plotted line shows a general upward trajectory from 1,000 in 1880 to a peak of ~3,300 in 1890, ending at ~2,950 in 1891.
